name: table-density-toggle
title: Table density toggle
description: Compact, comfortable or spacious rows: a small segmented control plus a context that every table cell reads.
docs: Wrap the tables and the control in TableDensityProvider. It sets data-density on a display: contents wrapper and every td and th below takes its height (32, 44 or 56px) and text size from it, whether it comes from this kit's Table or a plain table. value, onValueChange, defaultValue and storageKey work as in any controlled field; with storageKey the choice is remembered, the first render uses defaultValue and the stored choice follows. useTableDensity() gives a cell of your own the density. A cell that sets its own height and padding (a panel that spans the table, a message) opts out with data-density-skip, and so does everything inside it: a table in an expandable panel keeps its own sizes. The control takes what a div takes (id, aria-*, data-*) for the group of three.
